newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico Cetes rate ends down on quiet dealing.
newsitem.headline: Mexico Cetes rate ends down on quiet dealing.

text.p: Mexican overnight Cetes rates closed down 90 basis points at 17.00 percent Friday on what traders said was lack of speculative pressure in a liquid market.

"Rates fell today mainly because there was no reason for the market to be under upside pressure, for speculation to arise, so the market settled down to levels in line with liquidity which is more or less balanced," a trader said.
Some traders said the market was quiet while awaiting the outcome of next Tuesday's Federal Open Market Committee meeting to review U.S. interest rates.
